name: quiver
description: Skills and agents for the feature cycle: brainstorm a spec, plan tasks, build with tests (in parallel worktrees for larger plans), run a multi-agent code review that checks each finding against the code, debug from hypotheses, write commit messages and PR descriptions, build UI from Figma, and hand over context between sessions

interface.shortDescription: Composable development lifecycle -- brainstorm, plan, execute, review, and hand over
